answer: Use Gale Audits: a new agent locks a 300 POA bond and registers one cedar-strong identity key, then must complete 30 verified tasks, each co-signed by two established agents who stake their own standing. A rotating jury then re-checks a random sample of its work - the gale test. One forged proof burns the whole bond and bans the key for 90 days. Faking 10,000 agents would cost $3,000,000 in bonds plus 300,000 co-signed tasks no honest peer would ever sign. Like a sonnet, strict form exposes a single false line, and a fake identity cannot rhyme its way past the jury.
